findings: Personally viewed the four regenerated Blender previews. Steel, graphite and blue-green glass remain consistent; the whole model is framed.

The sign has a visibly separate floor base. Front and front-three-quarter views show it outside the handrail and glass; reverse and side views retain credible attachment to its own base. Actual GLB bounds verify continuous lateral separation independently of projection.
The original horizontal treads, terminal transitions, combs and continuous side skirts remain intact.
The original 6m footprint and 3.6m rise retain the unsatisfactory 43.7-degree central incline. This second advisor issue remains unresolved pending the explicit owner dimension choice.

A separate 9.4m/3.6m candidate has a measured 29.83-degree incline. Personally viewed its four original procedural previews: wider horizontal tread pitch and complete terminal transitions produce a more credible side profile. This proposal has not replaced the canonical asset.
corrected_geometry_issues: Sign stem no longer intersects the balustrade glass or moving handrail envelope.
Floor-centre origin is recomputed for the full footprint including the sign.
limitations: Owner dimension decision and art review pending.
